name: Become the League
source:
Embark on a journey of romance, lust and corruption with the extraordinary gals of the League.
You are Jensen, the newly appointed manager of a famous pop idol group.
A number of incidents occured that lead him to take upon this big responsibility.
Will he be able to save the League?
Or will he lead them down on different paths that would benefit himself, or others?

[Edited from [url=https://evjijii.itch.io/become-the-league]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与联盟中非凡的女孩们一起踏上浪漫、欲望和腐败的旅程。
你是詹森，一个著名流行偶像团体的新任经理。
一系列事件的发生使他承担起了这一重大责任。
他能拯救联盟吗？
或者他会带领他们走上有利于自己或他人的不同道路吗？

[编辑自[url=https://evjijii.itch.io/become-the-league]Itch.io[/url]]
